messages:
sarah.nguyen: Heads-up — Acme's EU subsidiary flagged two invoices that were issued in USD but their PO explicitly requires EUR. Payment gateway declined one charge citing currency mismatch. Invoice IDs: inv_2026_559, inv_2026_560. Can finance/dev ops triage?

omar.khan: Can you drop the invoice PDFs + decline code? need the PO too. :eyes:

sarah.nguyen: Here are the links and decline note:
- https://invoices.redwood.ai/inv_2026_559.pdf
- https://invoices.redwood.ai/inv_2026_560.pdf
- Decline: bank_code=402, reason="currency_mismatch", note="payer account EUR vs invoice USD"
- PO: PO-EMEA-7782 (customer requires EUR)

lina.garcia: Hmm — we recently changed intercompany defaulting. Could be billing_entity vs subscription owner currency selection bug. tagging @matt for billing-engine. :thinking_face:

matt.brown: on it. can you paste the invoice JSON payload from our API so I can see what currency fields were used (billing_entity.currency vs invoice.currency)?

sarah.nguyen: pasted below from /billing/v1/invoices/inv_2026_559:
```
{
  "id": "inv_2026_559",
  "billing_entity": "acme-emea",
  "billing_entity_currency": "EUR",
  "parent_org_currency": "USD",
  "invoice_currency": "USD",
  "line_items": [{"desc":"Redwood Dedicated - monthly","amount":99.00}],
  "vat_amount": 23.00,
  "total": 122.00,
  "po_number": "PO-EMEA-7782"
}
```

omar.khan: Whoa — billing_entity_currency is EUR but invoice_currency is USD. That mismatch explains the PO fail. Could be an edgecase when the subscription was migrated from the parent org. :warning:

lina.garcia: Finance rule is the invoice currency must match billing_entity_currency when a billing_entity is set. Looks like our invoice generator used parent_org_currency instead. Not good.

matt.brown: Repro steps for me: create subscription under parent org (USD), attach billing_entity with EUR, run invoice job for month-end. I'll run locally with the same seed. Also check FX rounding: sometimes small rounding differences (<= €0.01) cause PO line totals not to match exactly and banks refuse SEPA.

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice job completed: job_id=job_8341, created_at=1799921910, processed=inv_2026_559,inv_2026_560

sarah.nguyen: Customer is asking for reissued invoices in EUR (with same PO number) so they can pay by SEPA. They want a credit note + new invoices.

omar.khan: Finance flow: we typically issue a credit note for the USD invoice, then create a new EUR invoice with identical lines and VAT recalculated with current exchange rate, and set rounding policy to "round_to_cents". Lina — can you confirm approval?

lina.garcia: Approved. Please include a short reason on the credit note: "issued to correct billing entity currency per PO". :thumbsup:

matt.brown: I'll do the fix in two parts: 1) hotfix to prefer billing_entity_currency when present to avoid reissuing more invoices, 2) add a validation that invoice_currency == billing_entity_currency if billing_entity is set (fail invoice job and alert). Creating PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/482 — adding test and migration script to recompute in-flight invoices.

matt.brown: For remediation I'll generate credit notes for inv_2026_559/560, then create new invoices inv_2026_559-R1 and inv_2026_560-R1 in EUR using FX rate timestamp 1799921860 (rate: 1.08). Expect tiny rounding diffs; will force rounding to cents to match PO.

sarah.nguyen: I've opened a support ticket with the customer (ZENDESK-6120) explaining next steps and requested they hold off on retrying until we confirm. Also added decline code details so their bank can reattempt seamlessly after reissue.

omar.khan: After reissue, run a quick validation: compare invoice.total (EUR) against PO line total (EUR) and ensure absolute difference <= 0.01. If >0.01, escalate to finance for manual override.

lina.garcia: Also flag this customer for manual review for the next 3 billing cycles so we catch any other intercompany mapping issues.

matt.brown: I'll deploy hotfix to staging first, run the recompute script on a snapshot, and then run the remediation on prod after approval. ETA for prod redo: ~3 hours after approval.

sarah.nguyen: Customer expects update within the day. I'll keep them posted and mark Zendesk as "escalated".

omar.khan: Thanks — tagging payments/legal if needed later. Adding internal note: bank_decline=402-currency-mismatch, root_cause=srv_billing_currency_selection, mitigation=credit_note+reissue+hotfix.

lina.garcia: Great. Please paste final invoice IDs here once reissued so I can close the PO on our side.

sarah.nguyen: Will do. :white_check_mark:
